fields.constraints: Free text placeholder, e.g. [issue-number] or [filename] [format]. Claude Code: autocomplete hint. VS Code: placeholder in chat input.
fields.meaning: Hint shown when skill is run as a slash command, indicating expected arguments.

fields.constraints: Default false. Claude Code (v2.1.218+) also accepts yes/no/on/off/1/0 case-insensitively. true = only user can invoke via /name; in Claude Code also blocks preload into subagents and scheduled-task runs.
fields.meaning: Prevent the model from auto-loading the skill; manual slash-command only.

fields.constraints: Default true. false hides skill from / menu and blocks typing /name; model can still load it. Both user-invocable:false and disable-model-invocation:true effectively disables the skill (VS Code).
fields.meaning: Whether users can invoke the skill directly as a slash command.

fields.constraints: No official docs found defining a top-level type in SKILL.md in any surveyed implementation (Claude Code, Codex, Copilot/VS Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Junie, OpenCode, Amp, Roo, Kiro, Factory, Windsurf, Mistral Vibe). Only third-party (non-official) convention: metadata.type = workflow|tool|reference (community guide), and 'type:' tag prefixes in the ClaudSkills registry. 'type' does appear in Codex agents/openai.yaml dependencies.tools[].type (e.g. mcp) and in hooks (command|http|prompt|agent), but those are not SKILL.md skill-level fields.
fields.meaning: Not an official SKILL.md field. If a repo uses it, put under metadata (spec-legal) or treat as unknown/ignored extension.

fields.constraints: Only underscore-named field; combined description + when_to_use truncated at 1,536 chars in skill listing.
fields.meaning: Extra trigger context appended to description.

fields.constraints: Names map to argument positions in order, for $name substitution in skill body.
fields.meaning: Named positional arguments.

fields.constraints: Restriction clears on next user message; cannot remove EndConversation while other tools remain.
fields.meaning: Tools removed from pool while skill active.

fields.constraints: Same values as /model, or 'inherit'. Applies for the rest of current turn; org availableModels allowlist may reject; with context: fork sets subagent model.

fields.constraints: Available levels depend on model; default inherits session.
fields.meaning: Effort level override while skill active.

implementations: VS Code / GitHub Copilot (VS Code, experimental)

fields.meaning: Run skill in a forked subagent context.

fields.constraints: Used only when context: fork.
fields.meaning: Which subagent type runs the forked skill.

fields.constraints: Only with context: fork; default true; requires v2.1.218+.
fields.meaning: false = wait for forked subagent result in the invoking turn.

fields.constraints: Format per Claude Code hooks docs ('hooks in skills and agents'); supports 'once' option.
fields.meaning: Hooks registered while skill is invoked, kept for session.

fields.value_type: string (comma-separated) or list of glob patterns
fields.constraints: Skill auto-loads only when working with matching files. Cursor: legacy 'globs' still works as fallback.

fields.constraints: Default bash; powershell requires PowerShell tool enabled.

fields.constraints: Default true; false = nobody can invoke.
fields.meaning: Turn skill off while keeping files.

fields.constraints: None stated. In the spec, version is only a conventional metadata key (metadata.version). Claude Code docs listed 'version' only in the task prompt, not in the frontmatter table.
fields.meaning: Version string for packaged/shared skills.

fields.constraints: Deprecated; use allowed-tools.
fields.meaning: Legacy alias for allowed-tools.

fields.constraints: e.g. code, terminal, bug, beaker, rocket; unknown falls back to lightning icon. Only used for Custom Mode badge.
fields.meaning: Badge icon.

fields.value_type: enum(default, green, cyan, blue, purple, magenta, orange, yellow, red, brand)
fields.constraints: Invalid falls back to default.
fields.meaning: Custom Mode badge color.

fields.value_type: map of server name to config
fields.constraints: Overrides sibling mcp.json. Local: command, args, env; remote: url, headers; both: includeTools.
fields.meaning: Inline MCP servers bundled with skill.

fields.value_type: license: string; compatibility: string (max 500); metadata: map string->string
fields.constraints: Spec fields. Claude Code drops metadata that is not a map and says do not reuse frontmatter names (e.g. paths) as metadata keys. claude.ai/API upload rejects any non-spec key with hard error 'Unexpected key(s) in SKILL.md frontmatter'.
fields.meaning: Spec-standard optional fields.

notes: Key findings. (1) No official doc defines a top-level 'type' in SKILL.md; the only sources are third-party (metadata.type workflow|tool|reference; ClaudSkills tag prefixes). Recommend treating 'type' as unknown-but-tolerated, or hint to move under metadata. (2) The Claude Code docs say unknown fields are silently ignored, so 'invalid' for argument-hint and disable-model-invocation is a false positive. Only claude.ai upload/API packaging is strict (allowed: name, description, license, compatibility, metadata, allowed-tools). Suggest a two-tier validator: spec fields, then per-implementation extensions, then warn (not error) on unknown fields. (3) Claude Code docs on 2026-09-30 list: name, description, when_to_use, argument-hint, arguments, disable-model-invocation, user-invocable, allowed-tools, disallowed-tools, model, effort, context, agent, background, hooks, paths, shell, metadata, license, compatibility.
